visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with bangs and brown hair tied back is holding a pale yellow soft-serve ice cream cone in a convenience store setting. She takes a bite, looking surprised and pleased, while the camera uses a medium close-up shot. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. The background shows blurred convenience store shelves and lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of the woman standing in front of a 7-ELEVEN storefront. She gestures with her hands, wearing a white blouse under a blue denim overall dress. Graphic overlays of a full moon and a cracked egg with a yolk appear around her head as she talks. Pedestrians and a white van are visible in the blurred background. (3) The camera focuses on a brown paper shopping bag being held by the woman. Inside the bag are several large plush toys shaped like pompompurin and cinnamonroll wearing green pomelo-like hats, alongside several real green pomelos. She lifts the bag, then hugs the plushies to her chest, smiling brightly at the camera in an indoor setting. (4) Three small succulent plants in miniature coffee-cup-shaped pots (pink, blue, yellow) with Sanrio character logos are shown on a white surface. The woman's hands are seen using a dropper to water them. She then picks one up and attaches it to a black magnetic board next to a handwritten card that says 'HAPPY MOON FESTIVAL!'. (5) The final scene shows the woman back in the convenience store, holding the ice cream cone in one hand and a plush toy in the other, gesturing enthusiastically. She takes another bite of the ice cream while sitting at a window counter, looking out at the street. The lighting is bright and even throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat, synthetic pop BGM with a strong electronic beat. The vocal delivery is fast and energetic. (2) A mechanical whirring sound of a soft-serve ice cream machine triggers a new phase, blending into the background as the speaker describes the 'salted egg yolk' flavor. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (3) A brief 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition as the speaker explains the meaning of 'Tsukimi'. The ambient street noise becomes faintly audible behind her clear narration. (4) A crisp 'pop' sound effect occurs as a graphic of an egg appears. The speaker's tone becomes educational but maintains high arousal. (5) A distinct rustling of a paper bag and the soft thuds of plush toys being handled create several short phases. The BGM volume ducks slightly to allow the speaker's excitement about the Sanrio characters to dominate. (6) A sharp 'ding' sound effect highlights the mention of a limited-time offer. The BGM maintains its driving rhythm until the end as the speaker delivers a final call-to-action with a bright, rising intonation.
